PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Highly accomplished Capital Markets professional with 16 years of total experience, including 13+ years specializing in 
Investment Banking, Middle Office Operations, and Trade Lifecycle Management. Proven track record of evolving 
from core operations into leadership and transformation roles, successfully managing team sizes up to 20 members. 
Expert in end-to-end trade execution, confirmations, settlements, and reconciliation for complex treasury products 
including FX, Fixed Income (Bonds), and Derivatives. Adept at driving process improvements, automation initiatives, 
front-to-back coordination, and operational risk mitigation. Possesses strong stakeholder governance, RAID 
management capabilities, and transition experience, making them uniquely positioned for Markets Treasury PM/BA 
delivery. 
CORE COMPETENCIES & SKILLS 
• Treasury Products & Markets: FX Cash & Options, Fixed Income (Bonds), OTC Derivatives, Loans & Deposits. 
• Trade Lifecycle Management: Trade Affirmation & Matching, Clearing, Settlement, Cash & Position 
Reconciliation, Investigation & Exception Handling. 
• Project & Change Management: Process Migration & Transition, Automation Initiatives, RAID Log Governance, 
Business Process Re-engineering. 
• Stakeholder Governance: Front-to-Back Liaison (Traders, Counterparties, Custodians, Brokers, Senior 
Management). 
• Tools & Frameworks: SWIFT Messaging, DTCC, Omgeo, MS Office Suite, Escalation & Risk Control Frameworks.
